name: Ki Mystic
summary: A contemplative martial artist who turns ki into insight, visions, prescience, and shared good fortune.

features.name: Ki Mystic
features.summary: Gain an early Wisdom-based ki pool, +2 on Knowledge checks while ki remains, and spend 1 ki for +4 insight on an ability or skill check.
features.scaling: Wisdom modifier at 3rd; half Monk level + Wisdom modifier +2 from 4th

features.name: Mystic Insight
features.summary: Spend 2 ki as an immediate action to let a nearby ally reroll one attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Mystic Visions
features.summary: Receive a nightly divination-like vision by spending 2 points from the next day's ki pool.

features.name: Mystic Prescience +2
features.summary: Gain an insight bonus to AC and CMD.

features.name: Mystic Persistence
features.summary: Once per day, spend at least 2 ki to create an aura in which you and allies roll twice on attacks and saving throws.
